ModMetaData.name: Pickle
ModMetaData.author: RimWorks
ModMetaData.description:
Mod testing framework. Write automated tests for your RimWorld mod and run them inside the game. Pickle reads Gherkin scenarios and plays them against a live session: they click the real UI, wait on real ticks, and assert against the running simulation.
Other RimWorld test frameworks run unit tests against your C# code. Pickle works a level up, against the live game, so it catches the failures unit tests cannot see: a def that will not load, a conflicting patch, a job driver that stalls on tick 400.
Failures pause the game on the broken state and capture a screenshot, the log tail, and every colonist. Unattended runs write JUnit XML and Cucumber messages for CI.
Mod authors only. Needs Harmony or Concord.
